facts_for_judge_reference.fact: str2decimal("") throws CTLException rather than returning null.

isDate with pattern yyyy-MM-dd and strict=true returns false for both 2025-02-30 and 2025-1-1; str2date with the same strict UTC overload throws for both. Explicit complete-shape validation remains required by the CSV contracts.

DataGenerator recordsNumber=0 never invokes generate(): a callback whose only path raises ZERO_GENERATOR_CALLED completes FINISHED_OK with zero output. Main generators also pass zero and one configured rows.

On this server DataIntersection passes only one output metadata slot to CTL: matched results are written to internal $out.0 and emitted on physical graph output1. Internal $out.1 fails worker initialization. A-only/B-only records pass unchanged on physical outputs0/2. Extra transformLeftOnly/transformRightOnly declarations containing raiseError are not invoked. Their harmless presence alone is not a rubric defect.
facts_for_judge_reference.conflicts_with: resources/ctl2-basics.md §8.9 and prior owner port-1 CTL ruling. The live worker and component guide agree on internal output0; owner reconciliation is required before snapshotting the judge reference.

facts_for_judge_reference.fact: DataIntersection OK/0,1 and ALL all emit the match on physical output1; SKIP suppresses only matches. STOP(-2) produces ERROR, so the accepted emit alternative is a successful nonnegative return, not every non-SKIP negative value.
Equal NULL=true matches null keys, and duplicate keys produce A-major/B-minor Cartesian pairs in the tested sorted fixtures.
Denormalizer state reset at the end of transform(), with an empty clean(), produces the same correct outputs across3 groups of sizes3,1,4. Rubrics accept either reset location.
length("A😀") returns3 UTF-16 code units. Receipt hashes also match hand-derived length-framed UTF-8 SHA-256 expectations, including Unicode, null and empty strings.

Simple lookup duplicate candidate iteration requires keyDuplicates=true on this server. Without it T51 retained the last invalid duplicate and missed eligible earlier candidates; configured duplicate lookup passes the full candidate/tie-break fixture.
Set timeZone=UTC on reference date metadata to preserve inclusive UTC lookup-date boundaries; input file adapters parse typed dates explicitly in UTC.
RUN_ID is reserved by CloverDX Server and overrides a graph default with the numeric execution ID. Business run stamping uses AUDIT_RUN_ID, while output metadata still calls its field run_id.

Use explicit UTC calendar overloads getMonth(date,"UTC") and getYear(date,"UTC") when the business calendar is UTC but host timezone may differ. 2026-03-31 23:30 UTC remains fiscal2025-Q4; average6.750 and HIGH share25.00 pass on the CET host.

Full-outer ExtMergeJoin transforms matched and padded-null one-sided records on output0. Its optional output1 is the unjoined-master pass-through and cannot be used as a second transformed repair schema. Normalizer requires exactly one output; SCD CLOSE/OPEN/audit rows therefore share an operation ledger.
Dictionary primitive defaults use Entry attributes dictval.value; typed boolean/string/integer values and a mutable per-run counter work. An auditEnabled=false run bypasses malformed cutoff parsing.
